import json, hashlib, os

input_path = "/private/tmp/codex-recovered-timeout-demand/probes/claude/input.json"
result_path = "/private/tmp/codex-recovered-timeout-demand/probes/claude/result.json"

with open(input_path, "rb") as f:
    raw = f.read()

data = json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8"))
values = data["values"]

result = {
    "count": len(values),
    "sum": sum(values),
    "sum_squares": sum(v * v for v in values),
    "nonce": data["nonce"],
    "input_sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
}

with open(result_path, "x") as f:  # exclusive create: fail if exists
    json.dump(result, f)
    f.write("\n")

print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
